description: submission.rs process_update returns Result<(), Value> where the Err variant is a serde_json::Value representing an error object. This discards the type-safety of the SetError type that the rest of the codebase uses. The caller (handle_submission_set) must treat it as an opaque Value. Idiomatic Rust: return Result<(), SetError> or Result<(), BackendSetError<B::Error>> and convert to Value at the callsite. The CreateError enum in the same file is the correct pattern — apply it to process_update too.
title: process_update returns Result<(), Value> — stringly typed error
